user.archived_note: Reconstructed from Wayback Machine captures; account deleted in April 2022. Profile state from the 2022-03-16 capture, when the account was named "silicosis et" - the name it kept until deletion, and the one used here because a different, live account holds "KaneMining" today. Ranked 4K #1 at 14,181pp and #83 overall at the time; the best rank in a capture's 90-day history is #64 (2021-10-28), so the true all-time peak may be better. All 100 top plays are exact: the profile capture embeds the top 6 and two archived scores/best API pages cover the rest.
